en.ux.dirRtl: Words run right to left (the layout stays put; your choice is remembered)
en.ux.dirLtr: Words run left to right (the layout stays put; your choice is remembered)
en.view.spreadTip: Two pages side by side, like an open book
en.explain.save: Saves every edit of this service to an edits file you can import later.
en.explain.saveHtml: Saves this editor, with your edits, as one HTML file you can open anywhere.
en.explain.import: Brings in an edits file, a bundle or a saved editor and merges it here.
en.explain.exportEdits: Downloads this service's edits as one bundle file.
en.explain.exportAll: Downloads the edits of every service in one bundle file.
en.explain.image: Adds an image after the selected block; move it with the Drag handle beside it. Drop or paste an image file on the page to place it freely.
en.explain.logo: Adds a logo on the page; drag it onto the cover, the header or anywhere.
en.explain.addDiagram: Inserts a new workflow diagram you can draw and edit in place.
en.explain.addPara: Adds a new paragraph right after the selected one.
en.explain.redo: Puts back the change you just undid.
en.explain.find: Finds a word in the document and replaces it, one hit or all at once.
en.explain.newdoc: Starts a new document from a model, a merge or a crawl of a site.
en.explain.process: Opens the workflow: its roles and steps, which feed the diagram.
en.explain.outline: Shows the chapters and sections; click one to jump to it.
en.explain.pages: Shows thumbnails of the printed pages; click one to go to it.
en.explain.check: Checks the document for gaps and mistakes and lists what to fix.
en.explain.history: Lists every change, lets you approve or reject it and compare snapshots.
en.explain.renumber: Renumbers chapters, sections and tables in order.
en.explain.webhooks: Sends a notice to your own address when you save or export.
en.explain.theme: Opens the design panel: fonts, colours, sizes and template parts.
en.explain.styleThis: Styles only the selected block: colour, size, spacing, border.
en.explain.hideBlock: Hides the selected block from the page and the export; it is not deleted.
en.explain.side: Shows the Arabic and English editions next to each other.
en.explain.uiLang: Switches the interface between Arabic and English.
en.explain.dir: Sets the direction of the words, right to left or left to right; the layout stays where it is.
en.explain.ed: Switches the interface language and the edition you edit; the layout stays where it is.
en.explain.dark: Switches the editor to dark colours; the document prints the same.
en.explain.calm: Turns animations off for a still, quiet screen.
en.explain.focus: Hides the toolbar so only the page is in view; press F or Esc to return.
en.explain.spell: Underlines spelling mistakes in this edition.
en.explain.snap: Snaps logos and images to the page guides while you drag.
en.explain.zoomOut: Makes the page smaller on screen.
en.explain.zoomIn: Makes the page larger on screen.
en.explain.exportPdf: Exports the document as a PDF and a matching Word file.
en.explain.print: Prints the document exactly as the PDF lays it out.
en.explain.duplicate: Makes a copy of the selected block right under it.
en.explain.delete: Removes the selected block; Undo brings it back.
en.explain.moveUp: Moves the selected block one place up.
en.explain.moveDown: Moves the selected block one place down.
en.explain.comment: Pins a note to the selected block for reviewers; it never prints.
en.explain.breakBefore: Starts a new page before the selected block.
en.explain.keepNext: Keeps the selected block on the same page as the next one.
en.explain.rowAdd: Adds a row under the selected cell.
en.explain.rowDel: Removes the row of the selected cell.
en.explain.colAdd: Adds a column after the selected cell.
en.explain.colDel: Removes the column of the selected cell.
en.explain.rowUp: Moves the selected row one place up.
en.explain.rowDown: Moves the selected row one place down.
en.explain.replace: Swaps the selected image or logo for another file, keeping its place.
en.explain.caption: Writes a caption under the selected image.
en.explain.every: Repeats the selected logo on every page.
en.explain.ovDelete: Removes the selected image or logo.
en.explain.dgStaff: Adds a stage box for a staff step.
en.explain.dgApplicant: Adds a step done by the applicant.
en.explain.dgStart: Adds the start pill where the flow begins.
en.explain.dgRework: Adds a step that sends the request back for completion.
en.explain.dgSystem: Adds a step the system does on its own.
en.explain.dgDecision: Adds a decision diamond with yes and no paths.
en.explain.dgOk: Adds the end where the request is approved.
en.explain.dgStop: Adds the end where the request is refused.
en.explain.dgNote: Adds a note beside the flow.
en.explain.dgGroup: Adds a band that groups steps under one title.
en.explain.dgText: Adds free text anywhere in the drawing.
en.explain.dgAuto: Lays the diagram out again, neat and evenly spaced.
en.explain.dgReset: Goes back to the layout the diagram was harvested with.
en.explain.dgFlow: Turns the flow to run across or down.
en.explain.dgLegend: Shows or hides the key under the diagram.
en.explain.dgMermaidIn: Builds the diagram from Mermaid text.
en.explain.dgMermaidOut: Copies the diagram out as Mermaid text.
en.explain.dgLabel: Edits the text of the selected shape in place.
en.explain.dgSub: Edits the small caption under the shape's text.
en.explain.dgConnect: Draws an arrow from this shape; click the shape it goes to.
en.explain.dgDup: Makes a copy of the selected shape.
en.explain.dgDel: Removes the selected shape or arrow.
en.explain.dgFront: Brings the selected shape in front of the others.
en.explain.dgBack: Sends the selected shape behind the others.
en.explain.dgAlignL: Lines the selected shapes up on their left edges.
en.explain.dgAlignC: Lines the selected shapes up on their centres.
en.explain.dgAlignR: Lines the selected shapes up on their right edges.
en.explain.dgAlignT: Lines the selected shapes up on their tops.
en.explain.dgAlignM: Lines the selected shapes up on their middles.
en.explain.dgAlignB: Lines the selected shapes up on their bottoms.
en.explain.dgDistH: Spaces the selected shapes evenly across.
en.explain.dgDistV: Spaces the selected shapes evenly down.
en.explain.dgWrap: Puts the selected shapes inside one titled band.
en.explain.dgEdgeLabel: Edits the words on the selected arrow.
en.explain.dgBendAdd: Adds a bend you can drag to reshape the arrow.
en.explain.dgBendDel: Removes the last bend from the arrow.
en.explain.dgRouteAuto: Lets the arrow find its own clean path again.
en.explain.dgReverse: Turns the arrow to point the other way.
en.explain.dgFrom: Moves the start of the arrow to another shape.
en.explain.dgTo: Moves the end of the arrow to another shape.
en.explain.dgZoomIn: Zooms into the drawing (Ctrl + wheel works too).
en.explain.dgZoomFit: Fits the whole drawing in its frame.
en.explain.dgZoom100: Shows the drawing at its real size.
en.explain.palette: Opens every command in one searchable list (Ctrl+K).
en.explain.view: Opens the view options: page mode, dark, calm, focus, zoom.
en.explain.more: Shows the rest of this section's tools.
en.explain.svc: Picks which service's document you are editing.
en.explain.both: Applies a change to the Arabic and the English edition together.
en.explain.dg_wire: Picks the kind of arrow: normal, return, payment and so on.
en.explain.dg_kind: Changes what the selected shape stands for.
en.explain.dg_color: Picks the shape's colour, or lets its kind decide.
en.explain.dg_badge: Puts a small symbol badge on the shape.
en.explain.dg_icon: Picks the symbol this shape shows.
en.explain.dg_symbol: Adds a symbol to the drawing.
en.explain.view.mode: How pages show on screen: one long sheet, one page, or an open book.
en.explain.view.continuous: Shows the document as one long sheet you scroll.
en.explain.view.single: Shows one page at a time; turn pages with the arrows or Page Up / Page Down.
en.explain.view.spread: Shows two pages side by side like an open book, the cover on its own.
en.explain.view.prev: Goes back one page (or one spread).
en.explain.view.next: Goes on one page (or one spread).
en.explain.k_close: Closes this panel; your selection stays.
en.explain.k_q: Type the word to look for.
en.explain.k_r: Type the word to put in its place.
en.explain.k_next: Goes to the next place the word appears.
en.explain.k_all: Replaces the word everywhere at once.
en.explain.k_snap: Keeps a snapshot of the document now, to compare with later.
en.explain.k_log: Downloads the list of changes as a file.
en.explain.font.pick: Opens the font list: the project's fonts, this computer's fonts and fonts you uploaded, with a live preview.
en.explain.font.local: Lets the editor read the fonts installed on this computer (the browser asks you once).
en.explain.font.upload: Adds a font file (TTF, OTF, WOFF) from your computer to this document.
en.explain.font.remove: Removes an uploaded font from this document.
en.explain.vc.slider: Drag to change the value; the page follows as you move.
en.explain.vc.number: Type an exact value; digits and a decimal point only.
en.explain.vc.unit: Picks the unit; the value converts so the size stays the same.
en.explain.design.swatch: Picks a colour from the palette.
en.explain.design.hex: Type a colour code such as #003C7A; empty goes back to the design's colour.
en.explain.design.part: Shows or hides this part of the template (cover, control data, contents…).
en.explain.design.move: Moves this part of the template up or down in the document.
en.explain.design.label: Changes a printed label (a heading or a field name) for this document.
en.explain.k_laball: Applies label changes to every document that uses this design.
en.explain.k_addTable: Adds a new table to the template.
en.explain.k_addSection: Adds a new section to the template.
en.explain.k_dcssApply: Applies your own CSS to the page; it is checked before it runs.
en.explain.k_sthide: Hides the selected block from the page and the export.
en.explain.k_stclear: Removes this block's own styling; it takes the design's look again.
en.explain.k_embed: Puts the fonts inside the saved HTML so it looks the same on any computer.
en.explain.k_docxFonts: Puts the fonts inside the Word file so it opens right without installing them.
en.explain.k_texp: Downloads this design (colours, fonts, sizes) as a design pack.
en.explain.k_timp: Loads a design pack and applies it to the document.
en.explain.k_logoAdd: Adds a logo on the page; drag it onto the cover, the header or anywhere.
en.explain.settings: Shows the software's details, its update state and your preferences.
en.set.auto: Check automatically at launch (at most once every 24 hours)
en.set.st.off: Update checks are off on this computer (npx business-wrap update --on turns them on).
en.set.why.offline: Could not check: no internet connection.
en.set.why.no-access: Could not check: GitHub refused the saved token; remove .local/update-token, the repository is public and needs none.
en.set.why.no-release: Could not check: no release has been published yet.
en.set.why.rate-limit: Could not check: GitHub's rate limit was reached; try again in an hour.
en.set.why.server: Could not reach the local Business-Wrap server. Start it: in the Business-Wrap folder run npm run serve, then open the address it prints.
en.set.file: This editor is open from a file on disk, and a page cannot check for updates by itself. To update: start the local server and open the editor at the address it prints, or update from a terminal.
en.set.fileWhy: Can't check from a file: open the editor through the local server (npm run serve).
en.set.dataSafe: An update replaces program files only: your documents, edits and their history, fonts, logos and design packs stay as they are, and a backup is taken before anything changes.
en.set.explain: Explainer cards when resting on a tool
en.upd.title: Version {v} is available
en.upd.s.download: Download the release and check its fingerprint
en.upd.s.backup: Back up the current version and your data
en.upd.reopen: Restarting the server and reopening your document where you were…
en.upd.reloadSlow: The server is taking longer than usual. If the editor does not reopen, run npm run serve again and reload the page.
en.upd.failed: The update could not finish; everything was put back as it was.
en.upd.failedNone: The update could not start; nothing was changed.
en.upd.updated: Updated to {v}; your document is as you left it.
